He came of a lineage not unknown throughout the seven centuries of unrest, which make up Irish history. Tracing their descent to the ancient Earls of Comyn in Normandy, the de Burghs figured as vigorous instruments in the English conquest of Ireland from the Strongbow invasion downwards.

arxiv-2011-06179.title: Distributed Adaptive and Resilient Control of Multi-Robot Systems with Limited Field of View Interactions using Q-Learning
arxiv-2011-06179.creator: Pratik Mukherjee, Matteo Santilli, Andrea Gasparri, Ryan K. Williams
arxiv-2011-06179.description: Abstract In this paper, we consider the problem of dynamically tuning gains for multi-robot systems (MRS) under potential based control design framework where the MRS team coordinates to maintain a connected topology while equipped with limited field of view sensors.

arxiv-2308-03999.title: Understanding CNN Hidden Neuron Activations Using Structured Background Knowledge and Deductive Reasoning
arxiv-2308-03999.creator: Abhilekha Dalal, Md Kamruzzaman Sarker, Adrita Barua, Eugene Vasserman, Pascal Hitzler
arxiv-2308-03999.description: Abstract A major challenge in Explainable AI is in correctly interpreting activations of hidden neurons: accurate interpretations would provide insights into the question of what a deep learning system has internally detected as relevant on the input, demystifying the otherwise black-box character of deep learning systems.

arxiv-2406-04102.title: Chromatic Topological Data Analysis
arxiv-2406-04102.creator: Sebastiano Cultrera di Montesano 1, Ondřej Draganov 1, Herbert Edelsbrunner 1, Morteza Saghafian 1
arxiv-2406-04102.description: Abstract . Exploring the shape of point configurations has been a key driver in the evolution of TDA (short for topological data analysis ) since its infancy. This survey illustrates the recent efforts to broaden these ideas to model spatial interactions among multiple configurations, each distinguished by a color.

arxiv-2409-11169.title: MAISI: Medical AI for Synthetic Imaging
arxiv-2409-11169.creator: Pengfei Guo Can Zhao Dong Yang Ziyue Xu, Vishwesh Nath Yucheng Tang Benjamin Simon Mason Belue, Stephanie Harmon Baris Turkbey Daguang Xu, NVIDIA National Institutes of Health University of Arkansas for Medical Sciences
arxiv-2409-11169.description: Abstract Medical imaging analysis faces challenges such as data scarcity, high annotation costs, and privacy concerns. This paper introduces the Medical AI for Synthetic Imaging (MAISI), an innovative approach using the diffusion model to generate synthetic 3D computed tomography (CT) images to address those challenges.

arxiv-2502-04756.title: Concept Navigation and Classification via Open-Source Large Language Model Processing
arxiv-2502-04756.creator: Maël D. Kubli
arxiv-2502-04756.description: Abstract This paper presents a novel methodological framework for detecting and classifying latent constructs, including frames, narratives, and topics, from textual data using Open-Source Large Language Models (LLMs). The proposed hybrid approach combines automated summarization with human-in-the-loop validation to enhance the accuracy and interpretability of construct identification.

arxiv-2511-00806.title: Logic-informed reinforcement learning for cross-domain optimization of large-scale cyber-physical systems
arxiv-2511-00806.creator: Guangxi Wan, Peng Zeng, Xiaoting Dong, Chunhe Song, Shijie Cui, Dong Li, Qingwei Dong, Yiyang Liu, Hongfei Bai
arxiv-2511-00806.description: Abstract Cyber–physical systems (CPS) require the joint optimization of discrete cyber actions and continuous physical parameters under stringent safety logic constraints. However, existing hierarchical approaches often compromise global optimality, whereas reinforcement learning (RL) in hybrid action spaces often relies on brittle reward penalties, masking, or shielding and struggles to guarantee constraint satisfaction.

arxiv-2511-08204.title: Encoder Fine-tuning with Stochastic Sampling Outperforms Open-weight GPT in Astronomy Knowledge Extraction
arxiv-2511-08204.creator: Shivam Rawat Lucie Flek Akbar Karimi
arxiv-2511-08204.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Shivam Rawat Lucie Flek Akbar Karimi. Scientific literature in astronomy is rapidly expanding, making it increasingly important to automate the extraction of key entities and contextual information from research papers. In this paper, we present an encoder-based system for extracting knowledge from astronomy articles. Our objective is to develop models capable of classifying telescope references, detecting auxiliary semantic attributes, and recognizing instrument mentions from textual content.

arxiv-2601-15088.title: Five-point partial waves, splitting constraints and hidden zeros
arxiv-2601-15088.creator: Arnab Priya Saha a and, Aninda Sinha a,b
arxiv-2601-15088.description: Abstract We study the partial-wave expansion of residues of five-point tree-amplitude involving identical scalar particles in the external legs. We check the construction using massive spinor-helicity building blocks and by matching to the tree-level five-point Veneziano amplitude at fixed mass levels.

While there are a number of early publications relating to risk factors for COVID-19 infection, low sample size and heterogeneity in study design impacted consolidation of early findi

pmc-10536252.title: Unraveling complexity in changing mental health care towards person-centered care
pmc-10536252.creator: Karin Lorenz-Artz, Joyce Bierbooms, Inge Bongers
pmc-10536252.description: BackgroundMental health care (MHC) needs to shift towards person-centered care to better meet people’s individual needs. Open Dialogue (OD) is well-aligned with this perspective and brings it into practice. This study focuses on exploring the change process within a pilot project involving three MHC teams as they transition to a person-centered OD practice.

pmc-10560686.title: Drug-microbiota interactions: an emerging priority for precision medicine
pmc-10560686.creator: Qing Zhao, Yao Chen, Weihua Huang, Honghao Zhou, Wei Zhang
pmc-10560686.description: Individual variability in drug response (IVDR) can be a major cause of adverse drug reactions (ADRs) and prolonged therapy, resulting in a substantial health and economic burden. Despite extensive research in pharmacogenomics regarding the impact of individual genetic background on pharmacokinetics (PK) and pharmacodynamics (PD), genetic diversity explains only a limited proportion of IVDR.

pmc-10740668.title: A Multicentric Observational Study to Determine Myocardial Injury in Severe Community-Acquired Pneumonia (sCAP)
pmc-10740668.creator: Ignacio Martin-Loeches, Giampaolo Maggi, Emili Diaz, Judith Marín-Corral, Alfonso Guedea, Marcos I. Restrepo, Luis F. Reyes, Alejandro Rodríguez
pmc-10740668.description: Background: Severe community-acquired pneumonia (sCAP) is the most frequent admission for acute respiratory failure in intensive care medicine. Observational studies have found a correlation between patients who were admitted with CAP and the development of cardiovascular events. The risk of acute myocardial damage in patients with CAP is particularly high within the first 30 days of hospitalization.

pmc-10750562.title: Complications and Radiographic Outcomes of Operatively Treated Navicular Fractures
pmc-10750562.creator: Thomas R Johnston, Connor Donley, William McCormick, Samuel Schick, Michael Johnson
pmc-10750562.description: Category:Midfoot/Forefoot; TraumaIntroduction/Purpose:Navicular fractures are uncommon foot fractures and there is scarce literature exploring the complications and radiologic outcomes of these fractures. The aim of this study is to examine fracture patterns and surgical data to see the effect they have on complications and radiographic outcomes after open reduction internal fixation of the navicular.

pmc-11538202.title: Scaling up production of cephalosporin C by Acremonium chrysogenum W42-I in a fermenter using submerged fermentation
pmc-11538202.creator: Asmaa A Ibrahim, Ghadir S El-Housseiny, Khaled M Aboshanab, Ansgar Stratmann, Mahmoud A Yassien, Nadia A Hassouna
pmc-11538202.description: Cephalosporins presently stand as the most extensively utilized antibiotic in clinical settings. Acremonium (A.) chrysogenum is the main strain used in the manufacturing of cephalosporin C (CPC), which offers distinct advantages, including a wide-ranging antibacterial spectrum and powerful antibacterial efficacy. Our study aimed to determine the optimal conditions for scaling up the production of CPC from A.

pmc-11716972.title: Voxel‐wise Florzolotau (APN‐1607) Tau PET Covariance Patterns in Alzheimer’s Disease and Progressive Supranuclear Palsy
pmc-11716972.creator: Ganna Blazhenets, Joachim Brumberg, Hironobu Endo, Jung‐Lung Hsu, Lars Frings, Nils Schroeter, Sabine Hellwig, Chiung‐Chih Chang, Makoto Higuchi, Philipp Tobias Meyer
pmc-11716972.description: BackgroundFlorzolotau (APN‐1607) tau‐PET has shown distinct patterns of binding in patients with AD and 4‐repeat tauopathies. We aimed to establish disease‐specific tau covariance patterns in AD and PSP/CBS and validate them as user‐independent quantitative biomarkers for reference‐region‐free evaluation of tau‐PET in an independent clinical cohort.MethodWe analyzed Florzolotau PET data from four different cohorts.

pmc-12960059.title: FBXW7 Targets the SPT6‐ΔNp63 Axis for Degradation to Inhibit Esophageal Tumorigenesis Induced by 4‐Nitroquinoline N‐Oxide
pmc-12960059.creator: Jiagui Zhang, Lu Yin, Xiahong You, Xiufang Xiong, Yi Sun
pmc-12960059.description: FBXW7 (F‐box and WD repeat domain‐containing 7) is a classic tumor suppressor that promotes ubiquitylation and degradation of various oncoproteins. Although its tumor suppressor role in many types of cancers has been established, whether and how FBXW7 regulates in vivo esophageal tumorigenesis was previously unknown.

pmc-13070614.title: Plasma p-tau217 and glucose metabolism correlate in neocortical association areas in Alzheimer's disease
pmc-13070614.creator: Lauren N Koenig, Hanna Huber, Anjalika Chongtham, Guglielmo Di Molfetta, Randolph D Andrews, Ana Lukic, Neeva Shafiian, Howard M Fillit, Kaj Blennow, Nicholas J Ashton, Henrik Zetterberg, Dawn C Matthews, Ana C Pereira
pmc-13070614.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). While the biomarkers available for Alzheimer's disease are continually expanding, including clinically approved blood tests, not all of the relationships between various biomarkers have been fully elucidated. In this study, we explore how regional brain metabolism, as measured by fludeoxyglucose-18 (FDG)-PET, relates to plasma biomarkers such as p-tau217, Glial fibrillary acidic protein (GFAP), phosphorylated-tau (p-tau)217/beta-amyloid (Aβ) 42, and Aβ42/40 in a cohort of participants with early symptomatic Alzheimer’s disease.

pmc-13285713.title: Targeting CPR skills dissemination in schools and communities: the adapted Szpilman’s mannikin and AED
pmc-13285713.creator: D Szpilman, CO Cardoso, PN Sugimoto, BW Böttiger, NK Nakagawa
pmc-13285713.description: iopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) prior to emergency service arrival to improve outcomes.1, 2 Among several devices used for simulated trainings, an AED simulator and an intermediate to high-fidelity mannikin have been used for real-time feedback. However, the cost of these tools may not be feasible for CPR-training in large events, low-resource settings, virus pandemic, or very populated areas.

pmc-13602309.title: Anti-Contactin-1-Associated Membranous Nephropathy Presenting With Subsequent Autoimmune Nodopathy
pmc-13602309.creator: Ruben Visch, Shoko Vos, Pierre Ronco, Hanna Debiec, Karlien Mul, Tom Nijenhuis, Anne-Els van de Logt
pmc-13602309.description: A 70-year-old man presented with biopsy-proven phospholipase A2 receptor--negative membranous nephropathy (MN). Shortly thereafter, he presented with progressive sensorimotor polyneuropathy, initially consistent with an inflammatory demyelinating polyneuropathy. Laboratory testing revealed strongly positive anti-contactin-1 (CNTN1) autoantibodies, a rare antigen target recently implicated in a subset of MN patients with concurrent inflammatory demyelinating polyneuropathy, reclassifying it as an autoimmune nodopathy.
